creativeAssets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: large transparent hero product sculpture for premium Korean skincare and makeup website SHINE SKIN. Create a spectacular photorealistic luxury cosmetics still life, not a website mockup. TWO products floating together: a tall frosted pale ice-blue translucent glass serum bottle with a brushed silver cylindrical cap, 30 ml; and a round pearly ivory makeup cushion compact leaning open with a mirror. Precise modest dark teal typography on packaging: "SHINE SKIN" and serum subtitle "DEW DROP". Serum upright tilted 10 degrees, dominating the center, cushion low to its right. Wrap an oversized beautiful thick clear liquid-glass torus/ribbon diagonally behind and partly in front of the products, like a frozen fluid sculpture, with exquisite refraction, silver edges, water clarity, subtle pearlescent blue and lavender highlights. A few clear droplets suspended in the air. Camera three-quarter front with perspective, tightly art directed high-end skincare campaign render, clean studio directional lighting, luminous but tangible glass, readable packaging, physically believable materials. Composition: all sculpture and products completely inside image with 8% transparent padding, square aspect; compact balanced tall silhouette; transparent background alpha, no background plane, no floor, no scene shadows outside objects. Avoid plants, flowers, text outside the product labels, hands, boxes, gradients as backdrop, watermarks. Only two cosmetics and clear glass sculpture. Palette milk-white, silver and ice blue; no gold.

TOP LEFT: tall frosted ice-blue serum bottle with brushed silver cylindrical cap, SHINE SKIN / DEW DROP label. TOP MIDDLE: pearl ivory circular compact open halfway with mirror and pale beige cushion, SHINE SKIN logo. TOP RIGHT: low wide frosted white skincare cream jar with polished silver lid, SHINE SKIN / CLOUD RICH. BOTTOM LEFT: tall slim pale blue lotion pump bottle, silver pump, SHINE SKIN / AIR BALANCE. BOTTOM MIDDLE: slender glass lip tint tube containing muted rose pink tint with silver cap, SHINE SKIN. BOTTOM RIGHT: closed slim silver round makeup compact with soft ice blue enamel top, SHINE SKIN / SOFT MATTE. Premium photorealistic three-quarter front product photographs, precise elegant typography, soft studio shadows only directly on products, tangible transparent and frosted glass and pearl materials. Packshots isolated on true alpha transparent background, no surface, no floor, no background colors, no cell labels or numbers, no extra writing outside packaging, no watermark. Products fully contained in own cell.

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: full-bleed photographic background for SHINE SKIN cosmetics website, landscape 16:10. The attached blue flower/glass panel image is a MATERIAL AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate an original cinematic macro photograph/photoreal 3D botanical scene with enormous silky pale-blue iris petals folding through space, clear beads of water and layered sculptural petal ridges. Strong visible foreground/midground/background depth and real directional shadows. Broad flower petals sweep diagonally from lower left toward upper right; one large folded petal crest on the right, a gentle curved ridge and darker blue vein structure on the left so a transparent glass panel placed on top can clearly reveal and blur it. Palette luminous aqua and powder blue, cornflower-blue shadow folds, silver highlights, subtle lilac pearl sheen. Whole field is blue, not a nearly-white studio. Readable, softly lit area in the left center; pronounced blue shapes near the outer edges and right. Premium beauty campaign, tangible organic textures and macro detail, luminous backlighting, no clinical aesthetics. No products, no typography, no user interface, no glass panel, no cards, no watermark. Avoid abstract gradient blobs, repeated geometric stripes, flat white background. Original image, do not recreate the reference panel or its layout.

Use case: compositing. Asset type: square first/last frame for a seamless 6-second cosmetics video. Reference image 1 is the exact SHINE SKIN product identity and composition: preserve the serum bottle, cap, pearl cushion compact, materials, SHINE SKIN / DEW DROP typography and their geometry. Reference image 2 supplies the pale blue macro iris background and lighting. Create a new photoreal premium beauty campaign still: the same upright tilted frosted pale blue serum bottle and open pearl makeup compact float in front of layered blue iris petals. A clear flowing water ribbon spirals around the two products, visibly passing behind the serum and in front of the compact, with translucent curved thick edges, true refraction of the blue petals through the water, a handful of suspended droplets. The ribbon feels like flowing liquid with gentle ripples, not rigid chrome or solid metal. Camera locked, three-quarter angle; products and ribbon stay in the center 72% of the canvas with 12-14% padding on ALL sides, no object touches the edges. Opaque softly lit icy blue background, blue petal folds in middle distance, NO BLACK TRANSPARENCY, no floor. Strong dimensional depth, crisp labels and tangible translucent bottle, pearlescent reflections and silver cap, balanced lighting. Keep label text exactly SHINE SKIN and DEW DROP; do not add claims or new writing. No UI, no additional products, no text overlays, no watermark. Square composition with complete products comfortably inside the frame.

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original premium Korean cosmetics campaign macro photograph, wide 3:2 landscape. A large clear glossy serum ribbon curves through the left foreground like a translucent water wave, refracting blue directional light; beside it on the right an exquisite small pearly ivory cream smear with real thick cosmetic ridges. processing: Original native-alpha PNG outputs were encoded to WebP with Sharp, quality 92, alphaQuality 100, at the original 1254 x 1254 size. No compositional edits. Exact generation prompts are stored in the shipping .webp.json sidecars; the tool uses a sidecar fallback for WebP. Original PNG files with embedded prompts are preserved in work/asset-originals and the generation tool output directory.
rightsAndTruth: Brand packaging and products are design proposals. Do not use the imagery as evidence of actual product manufacture or performance.

videoAssets.prompt: Locked-camera seamless luxury cosmetics loop. Keep the exact two SHINE SKIN cosmetics, their labels, bottle geometry, silver cap, cushion hinge, framing and blue iris petal background unchanged. Only the crystal-clear WATER ribbon and suspended droplets move: a slow, smooth clockwise flowing spiral passes behind the serum bottle and across the foreground, with rippling liquid surface and moving refracted blue petal highlights, one graceful complete circulation over six seconds. Small droplets travel along the same curved orbital path and return to their initial positions. Fluid must visibly flow and change shape gently, not rotate as a rigid glass or chrome object. Restrained dimensional beauty campaign motion, tangible transparent water, bright blue light caustics, calm product hero shot. Keep products fixed, sharply readable and unobscured. No camera movement, zoom, cuts, new objects, extra products, morphing labels, swelling bottles, changes to lids, hands, overlay text or sound. Start and end on the supplied identical frame for a smooth endless loop.

processing.transcode: Both final renditions encoded directly from the original. Browser MediaRecorder experiment was rejected because its duration/frames were incorrect.
